report_text: Electrician worked on energized 480V MCC panel without applying lockout tagout or verifying absence of voltage.

A worker climbed onto an elevated platform approximately 8 meters above ground without wearing a safety harness or connecting to an approved anchor point. The guardrail was incomplete and the worker continued the task despite the fall exposure.
Electrician isolated 480V MCC cabinet, applied personal lockout tagout padlock, and verified zero energy using a calibrated multimeter before entering.
Entry team entered crude oil storage tank without atmospheric multi-gas testing or a designated standby attendant.
Personnel were standing beneath an active suspended crane load during mud pump lifting operations on the drill floor.
Worker entered storage tank after multi-gas detector confirmed safe oxygen levels with a designated attendant stationed at the manhole.
Welding team conducted structural hot work near open condensate separator without gas testing, spark containment habitat, or hot work permit.

A worker climbed onto an elevated platform approximately 8 meters above ground wearing a certified full-body safety harness and connected with 100% tie-off to an approved anchor point with complete guardrails.
Forklift operator reversed at excessive speed in a blind pedestrian warehouse corridor with a malfunctioning backup beeper.
Maintenance crew deployed ATEX Zone 1 certified intrinsically safe inspection lights and verified zero LEL hydrocarbons before entering separator vessel.
